title: On Poincaré--Sobolev Levels for Fractional GJMS Operators on Hyperbolic Space
summary: We study the monotonicity, attainment, and strict-gap regions of the Poincaré--Sobolev levels associated with fractional GJMS operators $P_s$ on hyperbolic space, where $0<s<n/2$. For noninteger $s$, $P_s$ is not conformally intertwined with the Euclidean fractional Laplacian $(-Δ)^s$, and we therefore also consider an auxiliary family $\widetilde{P}_s$ for which this intertwining property holds.
